root_causes.description: The shipping service exhibits a severe server-side latency anomaly (p99 mean ~5.7s, peaking at 9650ms vs ~2ms baseline) while its error rate, CPU, memory and pod restarts all remain normal and its only downstream dependency (quote) stays healthy at ~1.98ms. This isolates the fault to an injected/in-process latency within shipping itself, which then propagates upstream to checkout and frontend.

evidence.observed_value: p99 latency mean=5700.15ms, p50=4952.5ms, p95=9510ms, p99=9622ms, max=9650ms

evidence.expected_baseline: ~2ms (healthy) — downstream dependency is NOT the cause
checkout p99 low; latency is propagated from shipping

evidence.observed_value: no error logs found in window
evidence.expected_baseline: no error logs — consistent with latency-only fault

root_causes.description: Checkout shows elevated p99 (~9950ms) and is a direct caller of shipping, but this is a propagated symptom: checkout's error rate is 0 and its other downstreams (payment ~4.9ms, quote ~1.98ms) are healthy. Not the origin of the fault.
Frontend p99 is elevated (~8080ms) because it fans out to checkout/shipping; it is purely a downstream symptom of the shipping latency injection, with no resource or error anomaly of its own.

evidence.observed_value: frontend p99 mean=4951.9ms, p50=7357ms, p99=8080.5ms, max=8133ms
evidence.expected_baseline: low; elevated here reflects propagated latency from shipping

remediation_steps: Confirm a latency fault-injection / feature flag is active on the shipping service (inspect flagd configuration and the shipping deployment for an injected delay) and disable/rollback the fault flag.
Restart the shipping Deployment/pods to clear any injected in-process delay, then verify shipping server-span p99 returns to the ~2ms baseline.
Verify recovery propagates upstream: confirm checkout p99 and frontend p99 return to normal and that error rates remain at 0.
Add a p99 latency SLO alert on shipping server spans (threshold well above ~2ms baseline) to detect future latency injections earlier.
